messages:
Maya: Quick async standup for Greenline escalation — doing a short What I did / Blockers / Today thread.
Maya: What I did: confirmed webhook error spikes in prod, collected sample delivery IDs, notified account team.
Maya: Blockers: customer renewal is next week (2025-11-05), they want a fix timeline; still seeing 502s from our webhook gateway.
Maya: Today: need eng triage, a short mitigation plan we can tell the customer, and a CRM note with next steps.
Samir: On it — I started a quick trace on the failing delivery IDs (thanks Maya). Could be a transient upstream timeout or route saturation.
Samir: Can you drop 3 sample delivery IDs here? I have an idea to check our LB health and the backend retry headers.
Maya: IDs: dlv_8e9a, dlv_8e9b, dlv_8e9c
Samir: seeing repeated `upstream response timeout` in the logs for those IDs. Pasting tail of the gateway log:
Samir: ```
2025-10-28T09:12:34Z gateway: req=dlv_8e9a status=502 upstream_timeout backend=greenline-webhook
2025-10-28T09:12:35Z gateway: req=dlv_8e9b status=502 upstream_timeout backend=greenline-webhook
```
Samir: Immediate mitigation: increase gateway timeout to 10s for that route and enable short retry (1 retry) — low risk. I'll open a canary change.
Jen: Renewal context: Greenline is on a pilot; full renewal depends on this being stable. Can we commit to a customer-facing ETA for a mitigation within 2 business hours?
Samir: Yes, I can push the canary in ~20m and monitor. If canary looks good I can roll to prod in 60–90m after validation.
Carlos: I'll prepare a customer note: TL;DR + ETA. Maya, want me to include a link to the canary dashboard once Samir starts?
Maya: Please do. Also add escalation contact and that we're prioritizing their webhook route.
eng-bot: deployment-bot: canary job started by Samir — job id cnry-6123 — watching health.
Samir: Pinging eng-review: I have a small patch for gateway timeout and retry logic in PR #5234. Could someone glance at the config diff? It's a 6-line change in `routes/greenline.yaml`.
Samir: PR link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/5234
Maya: @Samir :thumbsup: — we'll wait on canary results. Jen, Carlos — please hold customer expectation at 2 hours.
Jen: Acknowledged. I'll update CRM: note saying we have an engineering canary + ETA, and we will follow up with a postmortem if needed.
Samir: Canary results: 15 minutes in, zero 502s for canary traffic. Gateway CPU and backend latency look stable.
Samir: Marking canary healthy, rolling to prod now (gradual ramp over 30m).
eng-bot: deployment-bot: rolling change cnry-6123 -> prod, started 2025-10-28T09:40:00Z
Maya: Nice. Any risk of request duplication from the retry we enabled?
Samir: We set idempotency header check for webhooks. Retries are single and guarded, should be safe. Leaving extra logging on for 2 hours.
Carlos: CRM note updated and sent to customer success lead. I included the canary dashboard link and ETA window.
Jen: Thanks all. Blocker moved to "monitoring". Will reconvene if any regressions pop up.
Maya: Today: follow up with postmortem draft after we confirm stability; please add any logs or notes to the thread.
Samir: I'll add the diag steps and the exact config diff to the PR description.
Maya: Closing for now — will reopen if we see new errors. :white_check_mark:
